headline: First Outside Appointment in 11 Years: Kim Jong-yoon Named CEO... Can Lotte Hi-Mart Overhaul Its Business?
summary: Lotte Hi-Mart has appointed Kim Jong-yoon, a former executive at major platform companies including Google, as its new CEO. It is the first outside appointment in 11 years, as home appliance distribution shifts online.
why: Lotte Hi-Mart is a South Korean home appliance retailer, and its strategy shapes competition in that retail segment.
